description: This Java source file defines the class ForwardActionExamples, which contains multiple methods demonstrating how to configure and send various types of HTTP requests and forwards using the MockServerClient API. It includes examples of forwarding in HTTP/HTTPS, overriding requests and responses, applying delays, and using different templating engines.

classes.name: ForwardActionExamples
classes.description: A class containing example methods demonstrating how to perform various HTTP forwarding and request/response modifications using MockServerClient.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTP
methods.description: Demonstrates forwarding an HTTP request to a specified host and port.

methods.name: forwardRequestInHTTPS
methods.description: Demonstrates forwarding an HTTPS request with scheme specified.

methods.name: forwardOverridden
methods.description: Shows how to override the request being forwarded, changing the path and headers.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Shows how to override both request and response bodies.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedResponse
methods.description: Demonstrates overriding request headers, body, and modifying query parameters, headers, and cookies in the request.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenAndModifiedRequestAndResponse
methods.description: Shows overriding request and response with detailed modifications, including headers, cookies, and body.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenWithSocketAddress
methods.description: Shows forwarding with a specific socket address.

methods.name: forwardOverriddenWithDelay
methods.description: Demonstrates adding a delay to the forwarding request.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForward
methods.description: Shows forwarding using a JavaScript template to dynamically generate request parameters.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForwardStripPathPrefix
methods.description: Demonstrates a JavaScript template that modifies the request path by stripping a prefix.

methods.name: javascriptTemplatedForwardWithDelay
methods.description: Shows forwarding with a JavaScript template and a delay.

methods.name: velocityTemplatedForward
methods.description: Uses Velocity template engine to generate the forwarded request.

methods.name: mustacheTemplatedForward
methods.description: Uses Mustache template engine for request generation.
